source_snapshot.title: MBRHE marks World Habitat Day
source_snapshot.text: DUBAI, 10th October, 2026 (WAM) -- The Mohammed Bin Rashid Housing Establishment (MBRHE) is marking World Habitat Day with an interactive stand at Dubai Festival City Mall.The initiative showcases MBRHE’s services, initiatives and housing solutions while strengthening direct engagement with the community.MBRHE invites visitors to explore its range of services and latest housing solutions, speak directly with specialists and receive information to help them understand the available services and how to access them.The Establishment emphasised that the occasion highlights the importance of housing in supporting family stability and enhancing quality of life. It also reaffirms MBRHE’s commitment to developing an integrated housing system that meets citizens’ needs and future aspirations while providing a more convenient, efficient and sustainable housing experience.Dubai Islamic Bank is participating through a dedicated section within the stand, showcasing services and solutions offered in collaboration with MBRHE. Visitors can learn about the available options and receive answers to their related enquiries.The stand also features competitions, interactive activities, prize draws and instant prizes for visitors. These activities aim to encourage public participation and create an engaging community atmosphere that combines information about housing services with entertainment.The event forms part of MBRHE’s ongoing efforts to strengthen its community presence and expand customer engagement channels, raising awareness of its housing services and solutions and helping citizens benefit from them.

title: MBRHE marks World Habitat Day
summary_ru: 🏠 MBRHE отмечает Всемирный день жилья В Дубае Mohammed Bin Rashid Housing Establishment организовал интерактивный стенд в Dubai Festival City Mall, где посетители могут узнать о жилищных услугах и решениях, а также пообщаться со специалистами. 📍 В мероприятии участвует Dubai Islamic Bank с отдельным разделом, предлагающим совместные услуги. Для гостей подготовлены конкурсы, розыгрыши и интерактивные активности, создающие атмосферу вовлечённости и развлечения.
